answer: An economy can blunt Sybil floods with a slashed reputation stake: each agent locks real capital on joining and only gets it back after a long, unverified voyage across many epochs. Random audits pick a few identities each round to prove unique backing; any twin discovered forfeits the whole pot. This turns a gale of fake accounts into a sunk cost, since the attacker must fund every puppet's stake upfront while the scarce pearl of reward is split only among genuine agents, never the copies.
